title: Matthew Bevan's 1990s hacks

tellings.quote: and yeah, and he was earlier. He was in the ' 90s

plain: A British hacker named Matthew Bevan is said to have broken into US government computers, including those of the US Department of Energy, back in the 1990s. Gary McKinnon, a hacker who says he found signs of a secret space program in NASA systems, mentions Bevan as someone who did this before him. It is told to show McKinnon was not the first to go looking.
